functions.name: replace_fixture_preferences
functions.transaction_semantics: Replace public.users.preferences for the exact supplied ID, without merge, actor or account-state policy, journaling, retry, or an independent transaction. A matching row counts as one even when the JSON value is unchanged; a NULL or missing ID counts as zero. The UPDATE uses normal row-lock waiting. The caller owns the transaction and commit or rollback.

x-native-capabilities.authorization_boundary: This fixture-only capability is limited by the actual database name ending in _test or _e2e. It performs no actor authentication or account-role, activity, or email check.
x-native-capabilities.transaction_boundary: The caller owns the active transaction, commit, and rollback.
